{{2024–25 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2024–25 Georgia State Panthers men's basketball team''' represented [[Georgia State University]] during the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Panthers, led by third-year head coach [[Jonas Hayes]], played their home games at the [[Georgia State Convocation Center|GSU Convocation Center]] in [[Atlanta|Atlanta, Georgia]] as members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2023–24 Georgia State Panthers men's basketball team|Panthers]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 14–17, 8–10 in [[2023–24 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball season|Sun Belt play]] to finish in a three-way tie for seventh place.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://sunbeltsports.org/standings.aspx?standings=112|title=2023-24 Men's Basketball Standings|work=[[Sun Belt Conference]]|access-date=December 3, 2024|language=en}}</ref> They were upset by [[2023–24 Marshall Thundering Herd men's basketball team|Marshall]] in the second round of the [[2024 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://wvmetronews.com/2024/03/08/marshall-tops-georgia-state-86-74-for-first-sun-belt-tournament-win/|title=Marshall tops Georgia State 86-74 for first Sun Belt Tournament win|work=[[West Virginia MetroNews]]|access-date=December 3, 2024|language=en}}</ref>
